title: Event-sourced system reconstructs state without explicit outcome object
operational_setting: A distributed application records events and derives current state by replay, without storing a distinct outcome object for every transition.
trust_boundary: Multiple services contribute events consumed by an independent auditor.
intended_transition: A business condition becomes true after a sequence of events.

attack.procedure: Represent the workflow only as immutable domain events and derived state, then test whether ART introduces any additional irreducible object beyond established event/state semantics.

success_criteria_for_attack: If event sourcing preserves all relevant control and verification information, parts of ART may be descriptive relabeling rather than new structure.

verdict.rationale: Direct prior-art pressure test against state/event traditions.
